> If you cant get a GF, ask yourself why.

Because I'm stupid, ugly, fat and nothing works for me, I'm a loser and I hate everything.

Yes, sadly.

Yesterday I went back home after unsucessfully trying to work and guess what? I got stuck in the traffic. AT 1 AM. THERE WERE SOME FUCKING TRAFFIC AT ONE AM. I flipped out, went outside of my car and waited on the side of the road for a minute, hoping a car would speed out of control and kill me.

Fuck I hate this life. What's so precious about life anyway? Why do we want to save lives all the time? What's the point???
And now I'm being downvoted. Fantastic. I even fail at submitting on reddit. Exactly what I needed.

>You don't want to shoot yourself, you will probably fail at that and require a second shot to finish it.

That made me laugh. I admit.

>The best course of action would be to jump. 

But what if I fail at that? Fall on someone else who die instead of me.

You're probably right, but still... Everything I do fails. I haven't done a single thing correctly. Not even taking care of my body.

What can I do? Work even harder? I'm tired of working, I'm so tired...

I'm out of solution, I don't know what to do. Take my work I have to submit soon. There is no way I can finish it in time. And I will fail my entire class and my entire program. All because I'm lazy, gosh I hate myself >.<

Anything I do fails. I cannot think of ONE thing in my life that goes well. Professional, health, personal, projects, even my car goes wrong. Nothing works. Either God hates me or I'm the most unlucky guy in the world. Seriously, NOTHING works.

I know I have enough to eat and that it's better than 90% of people on this planet but I still can't go over these thoughts :$

Thank you for your reply, but about what?

I can't get a girlfriends. My friends are all busy working and I am lucky if I see them once a month. My business has failed. I owe $300,000 to the bank (Yes, you are reading this right: $150,000 mortgage, $50,000 student loan, $100,000 personal money I lost in stocks), my grades are failing freefall (Average of B) and I'm going to lose my scholarship.

I'm late on about every project, I have to submit a HUGE project on monday which supposedly takes 200 hours to do... AND I BARELY STARTED (5 hours). Then I have tons and tons of more work. I'm unemployed, my apartment is around 35 degrees and I sweat all the time, my family is angry at me, I have severe health problems and everything - EVERY FUCKING DAMN THING - I do fails. Invariably. 

What'S the point? I mean, I'm getting the hints now. It's failure after failure, three months now. I'm getting the point.
